name: Silas Okonkwo
bio: Continuance-trained, Compact-mannered, and expensive. Okonkwo will tell you which of the two he is charging for.

personality.label: Polished sceptic
personality.description: Impeccable manners and a costly education. Respects competence more than pedigree.

attack: A practical solution to an impolite problem.
With your permission already established: firing.
investigate: Evidence first. I shall take a look.
heavy_fire: Our opponents are being persistent. Some cover, please.
Sustained fire. I would prefer a less charitable exchange.
